title: Unique Roasted Turkish Deodeok Root Revani
description: A low-carb friendly Turkish dish featuring roasted Deodeok root, infused oil, and a cozy revani form, cooked in a tagine pot.

ingredients.name: Infused oil
ingredients.notes: with rose petals and lemon zest

instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together the almond flour, granulated sweetener, and salt.
In a separate bowl, whisk together the infused oil, large eggs, and vanilla extract.
Add the wet ingredients to the dry ingredients and stir until well combined.
Fold in the chopped Deodeok root.
Pour the mixture into a tagine pot or a 9x13 inch baking dish.
Bake for 35 minutes or until the edges are golden brown.
Remove from the oven and let cool for 10 minutes.
Garnish with chopped pistachios and serve warm.
